assumptions.name: spherical null block, expectation form
assumptions.statement: null directions iid uniform on the unit sphere of 1-perp, independent of eps; (log p)^2 = o(n), (rank X_S0 + 1) log(pn) = o(n)

strength.conclusion: negative: E delta_n >= (1 - eps - L_n) L_n for n >= n0, L_n = (s0+1) [2N/(2p-1-s0)] sqrt(log(p sqrt(n)/(s0+1))/(pi n)), any null-block size N >= 1; all nulls, fixed s0, any p: liminf E delta_n / L_n >= 1; growing s0, all nulls, s0 <= p/2, any p: E delta_n = O(r_n) forces s0 = O(1)
strength.rate: (s0+1) sqrt(log(p sqrt(n)/(s0+1))/(pi n)) (lower bound on E delta_n; constant sqrt((a+1/2)/pi) at p = n^a)
strength.scope: witness designs only (orthogonal null block, or spherical null block with p >> n allowed); bounded p and bounded N included
